description: This file defines the BomRecord class, which models a bill of materials (BOM) record with fields such as manufacturer part number, store part number, customer reference, pad count, and user comment. It includes a constructor and getter methods for each field.

classes.name: BomRecord
classes.description: A class representing a BOM record containing part details and comments.

methods.name: BomRecord
methods.description: Constructor to initialize all fields of the BOM record.
